title: scrnaseq_nf pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow port of the scrnaseq_cwl STARsolo single-cell RNA-seq demo pipeline.

input.description: Path to the samplesheet CSV (columns: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2).

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.

reference_data.title: Reference data
reference_data.description: Provide either a pre-built star_index, or both fasta and gtf so the index can be built.

star_index.description: Pre-built STAR genome index directory. Skips index building when set.

fasta.description: Genome FASTA. Used to build the STAR index when star_index is not provided.

gtf.description: Gene annotation GTF. Used to build the STAR index when star_index is not provided.

whitelist.description: Cell barcode whitelist (e.g. 10x 737K barcodes). Optional; STARsolo uses 'None' when unset.

cb_length.description: Cell barcode length passed to STARsolo (--soloCBlen).

umi_length.description: UMI length passed to STARsolo (--soloUMIlen). Use 10 for 10x V2, 12 for 10x V3.

genome_saindex_nbases.description: STAR --genomeSAindexNbases used when building the index. Lower for small genomes.
